body:
I think this should be `InvalidStateError` for consistency with other APIs.

These specs use InvalidStateError:
* [Permission.query()](https://w3c.github.io/permissions/#query-method)
* [HTMLDialogElement.showModal()](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#show-a-modal-dialog)
* [HTMLElement.showPopover()](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/#check-popover-validity)
* [CloseWatcher constructor](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/interaction.html#close-watcher)
* [LockManager.request()](https://w3c.github.io/web-locks/#dom-lockmanager-request)
* [LanguageModel.clone()](https://webmachinelearning.github.io/prompt-api/#clone-a-language-model)

[ScreenWakeLock.request()](https://w3c.github.io/screen-wake-lock/#the-request-method) uses NotAllowedError.

`AbortError` makes sense if document was fully active when the call was issued but became not-fully-active before the call could complete. I still think we should use `InvalidStateError` because it's not important for developers to distinguish failures due to calling the method with an invalid state and failures due to loss of document activity.

`UnknownError` implies an unexpected failure, which is misleading since an inactive document is not an unexpected scenario.
